outcome: Opening an Experiment works again when the Lab started with sources that no longer compile
owner_impact: Fix for the Library 'Open' hang you hit with Constant Bearing Flocking. The Lab compiles the sources it starts with (your last workspace). Yours still held the old Initialization with set_agent_state, which release 4 retired, so the startup compile failed. That failure path had a latent flaw: the simulator never started, and 'apply sources' stayed disabled forever. Opening an Experiment first waits for the simulator to accept sources, so it waited 15 seconds and silently gave up. Now a startup error keeps Run disabled but leaves applying open: opening an Experiment, or applying corrected sources, starts the simulator. A new automatic browser check reproduces the case and runs on every release and in production. Test now: yes. Reload the Lab and open Constant Bearing Flocking; it should load and the setup message should read 'Roles: informed 80, uninformed 120'.
